messages:
maria (docs): Heads-up: planning v1 -> v2 migration notice. Short window: 14d soft deprecate, 7d enforce. Need docs + SDK + snippets in sync. I'll drop a deprecation banner PR tonight.

sam (sdk): Got it. SDK change: 'model' renamed -> 'model_id', embedding dims vary for some models, and streaming framing updated. We'll land a compat shim but need clear migration examples. I'll open SDK PR with tests.

june (devex): Owners: @sam (sdk), @maria (docs), @leo (oncall). Can someone grep repo for "/v1/invoke" snippets so we can patch quickly?

sam (sdk): Quick grep: `rg "\/v1\/invoke" -n docs/ examples/`
I'll add this tiny shim example for README: `client.call({ model_id: client.alias('gpt-4-redwood') })`

leo (eng-oncall): I'll schedule a small canary after docs PR merges and prepare rollback steps. Rollback command (for ops docs): `./ops/route-switch --to v1-proxy --reason "rollback: migration"`

maria (docs): Docs checklist: banner + dates, quickstart migration (what breaks + one-line fixes), update js/py/curl snippets, redirect map, add smoke test link. I'll take the migration quickstart.

june (devex): Smoke curl to add to CI: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model_id":"gpt-small","input":"ping"}'` expect 200. I'll add to /scripts/smoke/migrate_check.sh.

lint-bot: Reminder: PRs must pass link-check and code-block-lint or they'll fail CI.

maria (docs): Action recap: sam -> SDK PR + compat tests; june -> smoke script + troubleshooting bullets; leo -> rollback playbook & canary; I'll open docs PR tonight and ping reviewers.
